result.summary: All 6 hard checks pass for ISS-0122 / GitHub #388 test design. (1) tests/specs/ISS-0122.md contains 4 GIVEN/WHEN/THEN test cases (TC-ISS-0122-01..04) covering ASCII happy path, non-UTF-8 (0xE2 0xAA 0xAA) INSERT without C22021 propagation, validator empty issues[] after non-UTF-8 insert, and concurrent non-UTF-8 inserts preserving prev_chain_hash continuity. (2) tests/integration/audit_chain_utf8_test.zig has exactly 4 `test` blocks, each with per-test UUIDs (tenant_id/actor_id/audit_id via bpm.uuid.newUuidV4), each connecting to real BPM_TEST_DB_URL via TestHarness.init() which returns error.MissingTestDatabaseUrl on absence (no silent SkipZigTest), no commented-out bodies, each with try TestHarness.init + defer harness.deinit. (3) tests/integration/helpers.zig TestHarness.deinit (lines 601-608) contains the pre-rollback DELETE FROM audit_entries WHERE resource_id LIKE '<invalid-utf8:%' wrapped in catch {} so the sweep never blocks teardown. (4) build.zig has the iss0122_integration_tests b.addTest block (line 1221) referencing tests/integration/audit_chain_utf8_test.zig, the test_integration_others_step barrier dependency (line 1456) so it serialises behind the ISS-0106 cluster, and the test-integration-iss0122 narrow step (line 1463) gated on clean_test_db + run_iss0122_integration_tests. (5) python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration/audit_chain_utf8_test.zig exits 0 (no isolation issues). (6) python tools/lint_sql_param_types.py tests exits 0 (0 BLOCKER / 0 MAJOR / 0 MINOR). No DEFERRED, future-phase, or 'phase 2' wording in the spec. All 4 spec cases map to runnable integration tests. No mock, stub, or in-memory database used.
